eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Location and terrain only. OpenStreetMap has no mapped outline for this site.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:relation/2744502 historic=castle Q328352 314 m from ledger point
site is a site relation of 42 parts and none of them outlines the whole site, so no outline is drawn; the scene is fitted to the parts (372 x 361 m)
present-day buildings capped: kept the 60 nearest the outline centre of 239 mapped (trace size budget); the rest of the town is not drawn
roads capped: kept the 80 longest of 623 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
origin moved 304 m from the ledger point to the centre of the mapped site
49 mapped path(s) meet closed wall lines (candidate openings for T2; not drawn)
